markets.rules_primary: If Baylor wins the 4th quarter (excluding overtime) of the Baylor vs UCF college football game originally scheduled for Oct 30, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:

If the game is not started within 48 hours, the market will resolve to a fair price.
